title: Taking, Asking, Helping — and Mi Piace
label: ch:it-backwards-verb
canDo: I can say in Italian that I take, ask and help, and build a sentence with piacere the way Italian actually builds it — with the thing liked as the subject and me as the one it happens to.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson turns the set around: prendo, chiedo and aiuto in one run, then mi piace il vino read as the wine pleasing me, so the verb agrees with the thing and goes plural for le stagioni — and Chapter 3's one-word courtesy piacere is revealed as this verb's dictionary form.
